test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The radius of the base of a right circular cone is 9 cm and its slant height is 49 cm. Find the curved surface area of the cone.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The Curved Surface Area of a cone is given by πrl.

Since π contains 22 and r = 9, the answer must be a multiple of both 11 and 9.

Checking the options for divisibility by 9 (sum of digits must be a multiple of 9):

Only 1386 has a digit sum of 18 (1 + 3 + 8 + 6 = 18), which is perfectly divisible by 9.

**∴ The correct answer is 1386 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f2f765e760f92db513aba94447d70699fddf90eeec5f49fa8037251e8db5edc.png] 

**Given:**

Radius of the base (r) = 9 cm

Slant height (l) = 49 cm

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a right circular cone = πrl

**Calculations:**

⇒ CSA = (22/7) × 9 × 49

⇒ CSA = 22 × 9 × 7

⇒ CSA = 198 × 7

⇒ CSA = 1386 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1386 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Cone

The total surface area includes the curved surface area and the area of the circular base. Formula: TSA = πr(l + r).

Volume of a Cone

The volume represents the total capacity of the cone. Formula: V = (1/3)πr²h, where h is the perpendicular height of the cone.

Slant Height of a Cone

The slant height (l), radius (r), and height (h) form a right-angled triangle. Formula: l = √(r² + h²).
